[SWS_EM_01303] Cyclic Execution Control Sequence
⌈
The return code of Deter-
ministicClient::WaitForNextActivation shall follow this sequence: kRegis-
terServices, kServiceDiscovery, kInit, kRun, and kTerminate. Only the code kRun can
be returned repeatedly, i.e. more than once.
⌋

nate. Note that kRun is expected to be returned multiple times.
⌋
